title: DeFAb: A Verifiable Benchmark for Defeasible Abduction in Foundation Models
paper_type_zh: 可程序验证的逻辑推理基准与数据构建方法
best_for_zh: 需要精确逻辑奖励、溯因推理评测或可验证推理训练数据的研究者。
one_line: DeFAb turns public knowledge bases into more than 372,000 defeasible-abduction tasks whose hypotheses are checked for derivation, conservativity, and minimality.
DeFAb 将公开知识库转化为 37 万余个可判定溯因任务，并以规则求解器检查假设的推导性、保守性与最小性。
why: It makes minimal theory revision an executable acceptance condition instead of relying on a subjective language-model judge.
inclusion_reason: DeFAb exposes a deterministic terminal check for each theory-revision hypothesis, so logical outcomes can be reused as programmatically verified supervision.

title: Problem
问题
html:
General models are often asked to infer minimal explanations for anomalies, but existing abduction benchmarks depend on natural-language judges and cannot rigorously check whether a hypothesis derives the observation, preserves unrelated knowledge, or avoids unnecessary assumptions. A model may produce fluent explanations by rewriting the whole theory, conflating creativity with logical rigor.

DeFAb converts public knowledge bases into decidable defeasible-abduction instances. Models must add or override defaults to explain anomalies while satisfying derivation, conservativity, and minimality. A rule solver verifies every answer in polynomial time. The release also includes multiple surface renderings, a hard set, and the Lean-kernel-verified CONJURE subset, enabling exact rewards without an LLM judge.

通用模型常被要求从异常现象推断最小解释，但现有 abduction benchmark 多依赖自然语言 judge，无法严格检查新假设是否真的推出观察、是否破坏无关知识或是否包含多余条件。模型可能输出流畅解释却通过任意重写理论“解释一切”，导致 creativity 与逻辑严谨性混在一起。

DeFAb 将公开知识库转换为可判定的 defeasible abduction 实例：模型必须添加或覆盖默认规则来解释异常，同时满足 derivation、conservativity 和 minimality。每个答案由规则求解器在多项式时间内验证，数据还提供多种表面渲染、困难集和 Lean 内核验证的 CONJURE 子集，可直接形成无 LLM judge 的精确奖励。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is over 372,648 abductive instances with formal gold standards, derived from 18 knowledge sources and about 33.75 million materialized rules. Construction pairs taxonomies such as OpenCyc, YAGO, and Wikidata with behavioral graphs such as ConceptNet and UMLS and generates three levels covering rule completion, default override, and more complex theory revision. Each logical instance is rendered in four surface forms to test linguistic robustness. The verifier checks derivability, preservation of unrelated expectations, and minimal hypotheses. The authors also release 235 DeFAb-Hard tasks and 560 Lean 4/Mathlib CONJURE instances. The MIT-licensed data supports benchmarking, DPO preference pairs, and exact RLVR or GRPO rewards.

核心贡献是 372,648+ 个具有形式 gold standard 的可验证溯因实例，覆盖 18 个知识来源和约 33.75M 条物化规则。构建时将 OpenCyc、YAGO、Wikidata 等 taxonomy 与 ConceptNet、UMLS 等行为属性图配对，生成三个层级：规则补全、违约解释和更复杂的 theory revision；同一逻辑实例渲染为四种表面形式以测试语言鲁棒性。验证器检查结论可派生、无关预期保持和假设最小。作者另发布 235 题 DeFAb-Hard 与 560 个 Lean 4/Mathlib CONJURE 实例；数据采用 MIT，可用于 benchmark、DPO 偏好对和 RLVR/GRPO 精确 reward。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Integrate knowledge sources: Extract taxonomies, entity relations, and behavioral properties from 18 public knowledge bases, normalize predicates and types, and materialize rule graphs for default reasoning.
  1. Generate anomalies and hypotheses: Combine classification hierarchies with behavioral edges to create normal default theories, inject conflicting observations, and construct candidate minimal overrides or added hypotheses for Levels 1–3.
  1. Apply formal filtering: Use a rule or ASP solver to check that a hypothesis derives the anomaly, preserves unrelated conclusions, and has no smaller valid subset. Remove failures of derivation, conservativity, or minimality.
  1. Render and extend: Express each logical task in four textual or symbolic forms and construct DeFAb-Hard. CONJURE encodes answer definitions in Lean and verifies them with the kernel. Reproduction requires fixed knowledge-base versions, entity alignment, negative sampling, and solvers.

1. 整合知识源： 从 18 个公开知识库提取 taxonomy、实体关系和行为属性，统一 predicate 与类型，物化可用于默认推理的规则图。
  1. 生成异常与假设： 组合分类层级和行为边，建立正常默认理论，再注入与预期冲突的 observation；按 Level 1–3 构造候选最小规则覆盖或新增假设。
  1. 形式筛选： 用规则/ASP 求解器检查 hypothesis 能推出异常、保持无关结论且不存在更小子集；不满足 derivation、conservativity 或 minimality 的样本删除。
  1. 渲染与扩展： 将同一逻辑题输出四种文本/符号形式，构造 DeFAb-Hard；CONJURE 把答案定义写入 Lean 并由内核检查。复现需固定知识库版本、实体对齐、负采样和 solver。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The rule solver achieves 100% on all evaluated instances in under 50 microseconds per task, showing that gold answers and verification are executable and deterministic. Four frontier models obtain only 7.8%–23.5% rendering-robust accuracy on Level 2 even when scores on a favorable rendering can approach 65%; variation across chain-of-thought prompts is about 36 percentage points, larger than inter-model gaps. On DeFAb-Hard, the best model reaches 53.3% while the symbolic solver remains at 100%, and the CONJURE pilot produces no novel concepts. Results demonstrate surface sensitivity and theory-destroying errors, but automatically composed logical solvability does not guarantee factual naturalness or open-world creativity.

规则求解器在全部评测实例上达到 100% 且每题少于 50 微秒，说明 gold 与 verifier 可确定执行。相比之下，四个 frontier model 在 Level 2 的 rendering-robust accuracy 仅 7.8%–23.5%，即使某种表面形式最高可达约 65%；同一模型不同 CoT prompt 的波动约 36 个百分点，超过模型间差距。DeFAb-Hard 上最佳模型 53.3%，symbolic solver 仍为 100%；CONJURE pilot 未产生新概念。结果证明 benchmark 能暴露表面敏感和理论破坏，但大量训练集由自动知识图组合生成，逻辑可解不等同于自然语言事实真实或开放世界创造力。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Traditional abduction data often checks only a final label or asks an LLM judge to rate explanations, failing to reject overly powerful assumptions or damage to unrelated conclusions. DeFAb defines creativity as constrained theory revision and compiles three contracts—derivability, conservativity, and minimality—into an exact verifier. It also renders each instance four ways and evaluates worst-case rather than best-prompt robustness. This is not simply larger knowledge-graph question answering or symbolic classification: models must construct a new hypothesis object, and every candidate can be converted directly into an RL reward.

传统 abduction 数据通常只检查最终标签或让 LLM judge 评价解释质量，无法排除“加入过强假设”或破坏其他结论。DeFAb 的变化是把 creativity 定义为受约束的 theory revision，并把三条逻辑契约——可派生、保守、最小——编成精确 verifier；同时对同一实例生成四种渲染，以最差表现而非最佳 prompt 评估鲁棒性。它不只是扩大知识图问答，也不是普通符号逻辑分类，而是要求模型构造新的假设对象，并可把每个候选直接转为 RL reward。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Synthetic naturalness: Automated pairing of taxonomies and behavioral graphs can produce formally valid but awkward entity–property combinations. Solver validity concerns internal consistency, not real-world truth. Human semantic-naturalness audits are needed.
  1. Evaluation-scale mismatch: The release has over 372K tasks, but model experiments use much smaller Level 2 and Level 3 samples; DeFAb-Hard has 235 tasks, and some Level 3 analyses use even fewer. Small evaluation gaps cannot be extrapolated directly to the full corpus.
  1. Rendering and source bias: Four templates and 18 knowledge bases still impose fixed vocabulary and structure, enabling template or source-fact learning. Splits should hold out sources and entities, report each rendering, and audit upstream licences and lineage despite the aggregate MIT release.

1. 合成自然性： 自动配对 taxonomy 与行为图会产生形式有效但常识上生硬的实体—属性组合；solver 证明的是数据内部一致性，不是真实世界正确性。应抽样人工评估语义自然度。
  1. 评测规模差异： 完整发布有 372K+，但模型主实验只用较小的 Level 2/3 样本，DeFAb-Hard 235 题、部分 Level 3 甚至更少；不能把小评测差距直接外推到全部数据。
  1. 渲染与来源偏置： 四种模板和 18 个知识库仍有固定词汇/结构，模型可能学习模板或源库事实。复用时应按知识源和实体划分，报告每渲染成绩，并检查 MIT 数据中上游知识库的许可与 lineage。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Exact logical RLVR: Parse model hypotheses into rules and compute separate derivation, conservativity, and minimality rewards. Report all three before combining them into binary success to diagnose reward hacking.
  1. Preference data: Generate several hypotheses per task and use the solver to distinguish valid minimal answers, plausible but non-conservative answers, and failures to derive the observation, producing chosen–rejected pairs or rubric labels.
  1. Robust evaluation: Use identical logical instances across four renderings and report worst-case accuracy and prompt variance. For real-world causality, open-text explanations, or non-formalizable creativity, DeFAb’s closed-world rule verifier cannot replace human judgment.

1. 精确逻辑 RLVR： 把模型 hypothesis 解析为规则，分别计算 derivation、conservativity 和 minimality reward；先报告三项分数，再决定是否合成二值成功，便于诊断 reward hacking。
  1. 偏好数据： 对同一题生成多个候选，用 solver 排出合法最小解、可解释但不保守解和无法推出 observation 的错误解，构造高质量 chosen/rejected 或 rubric 标签。
  1. 鲁棒评测： 对四种渲染使用相同逻辑实例，报告 worst-case accuracy 和 prompt 方差。若任务需要真实世界因果、开放文本解释或不可形式化创造力，DeFAb 的闭世界规则 verifier 不能直接替代人类判断。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: DeFAb releases 372K+ decidable defeasible-abduction tasks and exactly verifies hypotheses for derivation, conservativity, and minimality.
  1. Method takeaway: Multi-KB alignment, default-theory and anomaly generation, solver-based minimality filtering, four renderings, and Lean CONJURE extensions are central.
  1. Data takeaway: It spans 18 sources and 33.75M materialized rules and includes 235 hard and 560 Lean tasks, directly supporting preference or RL rewards.
  1. Evidence anchor: The symbolic solver is 100% accurate in under 50 microseconds per task, while models achieve only 7.8%–23.5% rendering-robust accuracy with about 36-point prompt variance.
  1. Reuse decision: It suits exact logical rewards and robustness evaluation. Synthetic naturalness and small-evaluation extrapolation require source splits and human semantic audits.

1. 一句话定位： DeFAb 发布 372K+ 个可判定违约溯因实例，用 derivation、conservativity、minimality 精确验证模型假设。
  1. 方法抓手： 多知识库对齐、默认理论与异常生成、solver 最小性筛选、四种渲染和 Lean CONJURE 扩展是核心。
  1. 数据抓手： 18 个来源、33.75M 物化规则，并含 235 题 Hard 与 560 个 Lean 实例；可直接生成偏好或 RL reward。
  1. 证据锚点： symbolic solver 100% 且每题 <50μs；模型 rendering-robust 仅 7.8%–23.5%，prompt 方差约 36 点。
  1. 复用决定： 适合精确逻辑奖励和鲁棒性评测；最大风险是合成自然性和小评测外推，需源级划分与人工语义审计。
